impact: Strong AI networking demand from hyperscalers supports telecom and network equipment peers, a positive read-through for NOK and for AI capex at GOOGL and MSFT.
summary: Cisco reported fiscal Q1 revenue of $18.5B, up 24% year over year, versus about $18.13B expected, and adjusted EPS of $1.40 versus $1.33. Networking revenue jumped 43% to $11.13B. It raised full-year revenue guidance to $74.8B to $75.8B from $72.2B to $73.4B and adjusted EPS to about $5.47 to $5.52, and lifted its expected AI infrastructure revenue from hyperscalers to $9B. Q2 revenue is guided to $18.0B to $18.2B. Shares rose about 2% after hours, having fallen 12% over the past month.
title: Cisco beats with $18.5B revenue, raises FY27 guide; AI outlook $9B
